description: The full text of one maps-agent.com page as markdown: title, canonical URL, last-updated date, the answer-first opening, the body with tables, FAQs and numbered sources. Works for any public page on the site, by URL, path or slug. The structured result carries the whole page in body_markdown, with faqs and sources as lists.

form.description: Which form a bare slug belongs to, when the same slug exists in more than one.

ref.description: A maps-agent.com page URL (https://maps-agent.com/answers/how-to-get-more-google-reviews), a site path (/glossary/citation) or a slug from search_knowledge / list_articles.

name: get_article

body_markdown.description: The whole page as markdown: title, URL, date, answer-first opening, body with tables, FAQ and numbered sources. Answer from it.

faqs.description: The page's FAQ, also at the end of body_markdown.

sources.description: The sources the page cites; `key` is the footnote marker [^key] in body_markdown.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences: the page's description or opening.

topic.description: Grouping inside the form: answer cluster, guide kind, trade, blog vertical.

updated.description: The page's own last-updated day, YYYY-MM-DD.

url.description: The page on maps-agent.com — cite it.

title: Read a page in full
